banner.title: Matou te faatāua lou le faaleaganuu
banner.text: Matou te faaaogā kuki ma tekonolosi faapena. O kuki e manaʻomia e faagaoioi ai le 'upega tafaʻilagi. Faatasi ma lou faatagaga, matou te faaaogā foʻi kuki filifilia mo āiaiga, iloiloga ma le faatauga. E mafai ona e talia uma, teena uma, pe filifili i ituaiga ta'ito'atasi, ma suia lou mafaufau i soo se taimi.

preferences.title: Filifiliga o kuki
preferences.text: Filifili po o fea ituaiga filifilia e te faatagaina. E le mafai ona tape kuki e manaʻomia ona e le galue le 'upega tafaʻilagi pe a leai.

necessary.title: Manaʻomia
necessary.description: E manaʻomia mo galuega autū e pei o le saogalemu, le tufatufaina o uta ma le manatua o lenei filifiliga o le talia.

functional.title: Galuega
functional.description: Manatua filifiliga e pei o le gagana po o le itulagi ma faagaoioi āiaiga ua faapipiʻi.

analytics.title: Iloiloga
analytics.description: Fesoasoani ia i matou e malamalama i le faaaogā o le 'upega tafaʻilagi ina ia mafai ona faaleleia.

marketing.title: Faatauga
marketing.description: Faaaogā e fuaina ma faaautu faasalalauga i 'upega tafaʻilagi eseese.

blockedContent: Ua poloka lenei mea seʻia e faatagaina le ituaiga "{category}".
